scientific_integrity: The parameter-dependent proof is analytic. Script tests are supplementary, not a proof of quantification over all real parameters.
scientific_limitations: Strictly nonsquare rectangles and subcritical widths only; classifies all optimal single planks but not every optimal multi-plank arrangement. Critical scaling is one-sided. Literature overlap outside accessible records remains possible.
title: Oblique partial-plank optimizers for nonsquare rectangles and a cubic-root square limit
